senses.gloss: m. (κάππαρις, capparis) caper-bush, esp. the flowers of the caper-bush.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Maasrot 4:6">Maasr. IV, 6</cite>, v. <cite ref="R00540"><he>צְלָף</he></cite>; <cite ref="Berakhot 36a:22">Ber. 36ᵃ</cite> <cite ref="S01772"><he>קַפְרִיסִין</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Berakhot 36b:6">Ib. 36ᵇ</cite> (in Chald. dict.) <he>האי ק׳ ליתא וכ׳</he> the flower is no longer in existence, when the fruit is developed.—Pl. <cite ref="S01772"><he>קַפְרִיסִין</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Keritot 6a:53">Ker. 6ᵃ</cite> <he>יין ק׳</he> caper wine (as an ingredient of frankincense; oth. opin. in Rashi: Cyprus wine); <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 4:5:1">Y. Yoma IV, 41ᵈ</cite>.—

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 38b:7">Ab. Zar. 38ᵇ</cite> <he>הק׳ … שלהן</he> caper flowers (or fruits) preserved by gentiles; <cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 4:11">Tosef. ib. IV</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 5:11">V</cite>), 11 <cite ref="S00524"><he>קופרצין</he></cite> ed. Zuck. (Var. <cite ref="S01772"><he>קפריסין</he></cite>); (Y. ib. II, 41ᵈ <he>פנקריסין</he>).
